title: Ordinary evaluation and the precomposition differential
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $U$ an open, and let $P,F$ be arbitrary cochain complexes of $\mathcal O_U$-modules. Let $D=\mathcal Hom^\bullet(P,\mathcal O_U[0])$ and let $C_{p,q,n,r}$ be the projected ordinary evaluation component of [lem-pc-bounded-ordinary-evaluation-assembly]. For integers $p,q,n,m,r$ with $p+q=n$ and $n+1=m$, $(-1)^p(1\otimes d_D^{q,q+1})C_{p,q+1,m,r}=-(-1)^n C_{p,q,n,r+1}$ followed by precomposition with $d_P^{r,r+1}$ and the canonical degree transport from $F^{(r+1)+n}$ to $F^{r+m}$.

source.place: Tag 08DQ, ordinary complex comparison; Section 20.41, Hom-complex differential

proof.text: Split on r+(q+1)=0. In the supported case apply the projected dual differential formula, then evaluation naturality with f=d_P, a=d_D, and z=-(-1)^q. Combine the two integer-unit signs using Int.negOnePow_add and p+q=n. In the unsupported case both evaluation components vanish by their definition.

proof_origin.description: Compiled reduction into projected dual differential and evaluation naturality, followed by support and sign calculations.

theorem ordinaryEvaluation_pre_differential (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    (P F : CochainComplex (localEvaluationModules X U) ℤ)
    (n m p q r : ℤ) (hnm : n + 1 = m) (hpq : p + q = n) :
    p.negOnePow • ((F.X p ◁ (localEvaluationDual X U P).d q (q + 1)) ≫
        localEvaluationComponent X U P F p (q + 1) m r (by omega)) =
      -(n.negOnePow • (localEvaluationComponent X U P F p q n (r + 1) hpq ≫
        SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := X.sheaf.over U) (P.d r (r + 1))
          (F.XIsoOfEq (by omega : (r + 1) + n = r + m)).hom))
